MoltenVK fixes not yet on the `nxemu` branch of https://github.com/fab918/MoltenVK.

Patches here (`git format-patch` output, relative to the MoltenVK repository root) are applied in
name order on top of the commit pinned in `external/CMakeLists.txt`. Once a patch is pushed to the
fork, move the pin to the new commit and delete the patch.
